_about: Package ID registry. The Package ID (0001…) is the only package identifier (itinerary key; CRM, quotations, payments). Domestic, international and speciality packages share this sequence; Offer Codes (OF-0001…) have their own sequence in offers.json. Append-only once approved: never renumber, reuse or delete. Shown publicly (package hero, Quick Facts, itinerary header) only for approved IDs; 0001–0107 approved by the owner 2026-10-04. See docs/package-registry/PACKAGE-ID-MAPPING.md. 0054 and 0102 were rebuilt as distinct products on 2026-10-05 (owner) instead of being retired. 0108–0132 (domestic expansion batch 1: Kashmir, Ladakh, Amarnath, Himachal) added 2026-10-05. 2026-10-05: the 80 remaining package URLs with night/day numbers were renamed (owner rule: no numbers in URLs); old slugs are in previous_slugs and 301 to the new URL. 0133–0157 (batch 2: Himachal, Uttarakhand, Ek Dham) added 2026-10-05. 0158–0182 (batch 3: Char Dham, Sikkim–Darjeeling, Kerala) added 2026-10-05. 0183–0207 (batch 4: Kerala, South India, Goa, Rajasthan) added 2026-10-08. 0208–0232 (batch 5: Rajasthan, Golden Triangle, Varanasi & Ayodhya) added 2026-10-08. 0233–0257 (batch 6: Varanasi & Ayodhya, Vaishno Devi, Tamil Nadu) added 2026-10-08. 0258–0261 (batch 7: Tamil Nadu) added 2026-10-08, completing 250 domestic packages. 0262–0286 (international batch I1: Thailand, UAE, Singapore) added 2026-10-08. 0287–0308 (international batch I2: Bali & Indonesia, Vietnam, Japan, Cambodia) added 2026-10-08. 0309–0311 (Myanmar) reserved as proposed: built but not published until the owner confirms (owner option a, 2026-10-08). 0312–0371 (domestic phase D1: Andaman, Meghalaya & Assam, Arunachal & Nagaland, Odisha) added 2026-10-08. 0372–0431 (domestic phase D2: Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra) added 2026-10-08. 0432–0491 (domestic phase D3: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh & Telangana, Kerala, Goa) added 2026-10-08. 0492–0551 (domestic phase D4: Punjab, Bihar, West Bengal, Mathura & Vrindavan, Rajasthan, Golden Triangle, Varanasi & Ayodhya, Char Dham, Uttarakhand) added 2026-10-08. 0552–0611 (domestic phase D5: Himachal, Kashmir, Ladakh, Sikkim & Darjeeling, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka & Ooty, Uttarakhand, Kerala, Vaishno Devi, Amarnath) added 2026-10-08, completing 550 domestic packages.
